spec_match.rationale: Compares the materialise-then-join workaround against the native accumulate-as-you-go join at user-chosen sizes, with the peak-intermediate framing the proposal motivates.

interactive.rationale: Size select, repetitions input and run button produce live bars, a results table and heap rows (verified).

blurb_alignment.rationale: Blurb promises identical output at different peak footprint, and the page measures exactly that — explicitly demoting raw time as the argument.

edge_cases.rationale: Honest performance.memory handling: sampled with caveats where present, 'not exposed' where absent, never an invented number.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Run executed at 200k values; routes-agree assert verified the two outputs identical; console clean.

telemetry_health.rationale: routes-agree asserts output identity — falsifiable and on-contract.

design_system.rationale: Bars and tables on CSS variables.

accessibility.rationale: Controls labelled, output aria-live, visible focus.

summary: Verified on headless Chromium 153 (Chrome for Testing 153.0.8010.12) driven over CDP via a Playwright script — chrome-devtools-mcp is unavailable in this cloud environment; desktop 1280×800 and mobile 360×740 DPR3 full-page screenshots captured and inspected. Measured honestly (routes agree; time explicitly framed as not the argument) and native on this build.
